title: Array destructuring unpacks by position
why_it_matters: This is exactly how you read useState in React.
explanation: Destructuring pulls items out of an array into named variables, by position. ...rest collects the leftovers. As a bonus, [x, y] = [y, x] swaps two variables without a temporary one. React's useState returns an array, so you destructure it.
try_it: Swap two variables of your own using destructuring.
